hero.title: Your Island Escape, Between Two Volcanoes
hero.description: Slow down and settle into Ometepe's rural heart, where wooden architecture and the lake's easy rhythm invite you to reconnect.

identity.label: Visual identity
identity.description: Two volcanoes meet the lake's horizon.
identity.symbolLabel: Symbol of two volcanoes, the horizon, and water

architecture.title: A handcrafted retreat in Ometepe's countryside
paragraphs: At Tiki, we believe the real luxury is rest, time in nature, and connection with others. The wooden structure is designed to let the breeze from Lake Cocibolca flow through.
Here, nature sets the pace. Wake up to birdsong, share meals and stories, and get to know the island's rural rhythms.
architecture.featuresLabel: Features in the Tiki design concept
features: Wooden Spaces Open to the Breeze
architecture.quote: “The wood creaks softly at night, reminding us that we're alive here in the heart of the island.”

spaces.title: Spaces made for connection and rest

cards.title: Private Wooden Cabins
cards.description: Handcrafted rooms with plenty of privacy and a close connection to the surrounding landscape.

cards.title: Shared Dorm Rooms
cards.description: Sturdy native-wood bunk beds, personal space, and a steady flow of fresh air for travelers with stories to share.

cards.title: Shared Kitchen & Fire Pit
cards.description: Open spaces to prepare local food, gather around the fire at night, and swap stories about where to go next.

experience.title: The people who welcome you make Tiki what it is
paragraphs: Tiki is more than a stop on the map. It's a home away from home, cared for by people who love the island. We believe in warm, open, down-to-earth hospitality.

Here, you won't find plastic wristbands or corporate formalities. You'll find freshly brewed coffee in the morning, honest tips for exploring local volcanic trails, and plenty of respect for the quiet around us.
